# A responder never guesses. Four refusals, each for a different reason.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|0a1b2c3d|call,read,report
OBS|part|0a1b2c3d|target|deck
OBS|part|0a1b2c3d|gpu|AMD Custom GPU 0405 (gfx1033)
OBS|part|0a1b2c3d|probe|dev
OBS|done|1|ok||
# Not in the grammar at all.
CMD|2|disassemble|0x1000|0x40
OBS|ack|2|disassemble
OBS|refused|2|unknown-verb
# In the grammar, and not announced by this target. A stand-in part has no system
# libraries, so it cannot answer a question about one - and says so rather than guessing.
CMD|3|resolve|libkernel|sceKernelWrite
OBS|ack|3|resolve
OBS|refused|3|not-negotiated
# Announced, but this build has writes disabled.
CMD|4|write|0x8100000|deadbeef
OBS|ack|4|write
OBS|refused|4|unsupported
# Malformed: a length that is not a number.
CMD|5|read|0x8100000|lots
OBS|ack|5|read
OBS|refused|5|bad-argument
